# Examples: transferAndDeleteTerritories

**POST /settings/territories/actions/transfer_and_delete**

## Request examples

### `application/json` — TerritoryTransferAndDelete

Transfer and delete territories

```json
{
  "territories": [
    {
      "id": "431581000000798016",
      "transfer_to_id": "431581000000272796",
      "delete_previous_forecasts": true
    }
  ]
}
```

## Response examples

### Status `200` — `application/json` — AutoGeneratedExample

Successful territory transfer and delete

```json
{
  "territories": [
    {
      "code": "SUCCESS",
      "details": {
        "id": "431581000000798016"
      },
      "message": "Territory Transferred And Deleted Successfully",
      "status": "success"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Status `400` — `application/json` — InvalidTerritoryIdError

Territory invalid data error

```json
{
  "territories": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_DATA",
      "details": {
        "api_name": "id",
        "json_path": "$.territories[0].id"
      },
      "message": "Given Territoryid isn't valid one",
      "status": "error"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Status `400` — `application/json` — InvalidTransferToTerritoryIdError

Invalid transfer_to_id territory error

```json
{
  "territories": [
    {
      "code": "INVALID_DATA",
      "details": {
        "api_name": "transfer_to_id",
        "json_path": "$.territories[0].transfer_to_id"
      },
      "message": "Given transfer_to_id isn't valid one",
      "status": "error"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Status `400` — `application/json` — DependentFieldMissing

Dependent transfer_to_id missing error when territory has child territories

```json
{
  "territories": [
    {
      "code": "DEPENDENT_FIELD_MISSING",
      "details": {
        "api_name": "transfer_to_id",
        "json_path": "$.territories[0].transfer_to_id",
        "dependee": {
          "api_name": "id",
          "json_path": "$.territories[0].id"
        }
      },
      "message": "This territory has its child. Please Give the transfer_to_id field value",
      "status": "error"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Status `400` — `application/json` — TerritoryNotYetEnabled

Territory Management not yet enabled error

```json
{
  "code": "FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED",
  "details": {},
  "message": "Territory Management is not enabled",
  "status": "error"
}
```

### Status `400` — `application/json` — TerritoryDisabled

Territory Management disabled error

```json
{
  "code": "FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED",
  "details": {},
  "message": "Territory Management is disabled",
  "status": "error"
}
```

### Status `401` — `application/json` — AuthenticationFailure

Authentication failure

```json
{
  "code": "AUTHENTICATION_FAILURE",
  "details": {},
  "message": "Authentication failed",
  "status": "error"
}
```
